description: Buddy Phase 25 — System Hardening & Closed-Loop Activation. Phase 24 fixed RL feedback integrity. Phase 25 activates disabled-but-built modules and hardens risk enforcement. Key findings: (1) agent_lifecycle tracks fitness but never applies quarantine to voting weights, (2) real-time correlation enforcement gaps allow double exposure, (3) learning engine consolidation rules exist but no automation, (4) threshold_optimizer built but defaulted to False — never auto-tunes gates, (5) observation_consumer enabled in continuous.py but orchestrator path still disconnected, (6) agent_accuracy_matrix built but defaulted to False — agent per-pair performance never tracked. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Apply agent lifecycle quarantine to voting weights
userStories.description: agent_lifecycle.py tracks agent fitness and quarantine status, but quarantined agents still vote at full weight. Wire lifecycle status into ScannerAgentTeam so quarantined agents get 0.3x weight and retired agents get 0x.
acceptanceCriteria: In ScannerAgentTeam.evaluate(), check agent_lifecycle status for each agent before vote
If agent status is QUARANTINED, multiply its weight by 0.3
If agent status is RETIRED, skip its vote entirely (weight 0)
Guard with enable_agent_lifecycle config flag
Log lifecycle-adjusted weights when applied
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Changed enable_agent_lifecycle default to True in config.py. Enhanced lifecycle modifier logging in _team.py lines 805-823 with US-151 prefix and per-agent modifier detail.

userStories.title: Real-time correlation enforcement before execution
userStories.description: Correlation filter runs during scan but execution path can still open correlated positions. Add explicit correlation check in execute_trade() against currently open OANDA positions.
acceptanceCriteria: In execution.py execute_trade(), before placing order, fetch open trades and check correlation
If new pair has > 0.80 correlation with any open position, block trade with reason
Log blocked correlated trades to observation_log category='correlation_block'
Use cached correlation matrix from scanner if available, else compute from recent returns
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added real-time correlation enforcement in execute_trade() after spread check. Uses static _CORR_PAIRS map for 10 high-correlation pair groups. Blocks with ExecutionResult(success=False) and logs to observation_log category='correlation_block'.

userStories.title: Auto-enable threshold_optimizer in continuous mode
userStories.description: ThresholdOptimizer (US-133) is built and has journal replay warm-start, but config defaults to False. Enable it by default and wire gate feedback from every scan cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Change enable_threshold_optimizer config default to True
In continuous.py, after each scan, feed gate pass/fail + outcome to threshold_optimizer.record_outcome()
Every 10 cycles, call threshold_optimizer.compute_adjustments() and apply to scanner.config
Log threshold adjustments with before/after values
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Changed enable_threshold_optimizer default to True. Added step 3c in continuous.py _run_smart_loop() — reads journal entries, extracts gate values, calls _to.update_outcome() per trade. Every 10 cycles calls optimize_thresholds() per regime and saves state.

userStories.title: Automated learnings consolidation pipeline
userStories.description: improvement.md defines consolidation rules (archive >30 entries, split >50 lines, prune >100 config entries) but no automation exists. Add consolidation check to orchestrator.
acceptanceCriteria: In orchestrator.py run_cycle(), check learnings.md entry count every 50 cycles
If > 30 entries, archive entries older than 30 days to learnings_archive.md
If config_adjustments.json > 100 entries, prune entries older than 30 days
Log consolidation actions with counts
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added Step 13 in orchestrator.py run_cycle() before return — runs every 50 cycles. Archives learnings older than 30 days to learnings_archive.md if > 30 entries. Prunes config_adjustments.json entries older than 30 days if > 100 entries. Non-blocking with try/except.

userStories.title: Enable agent_accuracy_matrix for per-pair agent performance
userStories.description: agent_accuracy_matrix.py exists with track() and get_accuracy() but defaults to False. Enable and wire into RL sync so agent accuracy per pair/regime is tracked from trade outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Change enable_agent_accuracy_matrix config default to True
In execution.py sync_closed_trades_rl(), after RL weight update, call accuracy_matrix.track() for each agent verdict
In ScannerAgentTeam, if accuracy_matrix available, use per-pair accuracy to boost/penalize agent weights
Log accuracy matrix updates
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Changed enable_agent_accuracy_matrix default to True. Wired record_verdict() into sync_closed_trades_rl() — records each passing agent's verdict with pair/regime/direction/outcome. Injected _accuracy_matrix from Scanner into ScannerAgentTeam. In evaluate(), calls get_regime_weights() to apply per-pair weight boosts/penalties before voting. Logs adjustments with US-155 prefix.

userStories.title: Weight decay for stale agents without recent trades
userStories.description: Agent weights persist indefinitely. An agent that was accurate 100 trades ago keeps full weight even if it hasn't contributed to a winning trade in 50 trades. Add time-based weight decay.
acceptanceCriteria: In ScannerAgentTeam, track last_trade_timestamp per agent in _learned_weights metadata
Every 50 trades (from _meta.total_trades), apply 0.95x decay to agents with no trades in last 20
Minimum decayed weight is 0.5 (never fully kill an agent via decay alone)
Log decay application with agent names and new weights
Syntax validation passes
userStories.notes: Added last_trade_per_agent tracking in _meta section of _learned_weights. Records trade count per agent when they pass a verdict. Every 50 total trades, applies 0.95x decay to agents with no trades in last 20, floor of 0.5. Logs decayed agents with US-156 prefix.
